lines.text: You're a real stand up one, Old-Timer!
Hey Old-Timer, did you come to see Belorta?
Belorta may tease a whole lot, but she's still my friend.
If it weren't for you encouraging me, Belorta would be the only friend I ever had! Thanks, Old-Timer!
You'll always be with me and Belorta, won't you?
As for me, I hope you and Belorta will both live a happy life!

Wait a sec, is this the same hide and seek game Belorta and I play?
Hehe, this time I will be the seeker to find Old-Timer!
Stop by the toy shop if you have the time! That's where you'll find Belorta and I.
Belorta is always messing with me...
Whoa, this place is packed with all sorts of gizmos and gadgets! Neato!
This is the first time anyone has ever given me something like this.
As long as I've got you and Belorta, I don't need anyone else!
If you made me pick between you and Belorta... I could never choose.
I'm growing fonder of you all the time!
Some firecrackers ought to do the trick, don't you think?
Can we hang out after we're done here?
Looks like these guys woke up on the wrong side of the bed this morning!
Ow... My arm is killing me!
